aggregation.method: Per-variable 10-minute LMST bins; arithmetic mean of valid native samples (circular mean for wind direction).

displayWindow.selectionRule: 6 sols (100, 140, 180, 220, 265, 300) inside sols 36-315, the only interval with a derived wind product in this PDS release, and after the sol-63 humidity commissioning limit. Sols without a complete six-instrument product set were replaced.

availability.reason: No validated dust-opacity product exists in the calibrated or derived MEDA CSV collections used here. SkyCam tau imagery was not processed in this milestone.
No verified Jezero ionizing-dose product is integrated. MEDA RDS photodiodes are solar/UV sensors; their values are never converted to dose.

limitations: These are rover-local MEDA observations at the Perseverance workspace, not area-wide Jezero Crater conditions.
No historical observation in this dataset predicts future EVA conditions.
Air temperature is reported per ATS detector; detectors are never averaged into one undisclosed value.
TIRS GROUND_TEMP is ground brightness temperature in the 8-14 µm band, not kinetic surface temperature.
MEDA RDS values are FOV-integrated photodiode radiance in W/m²; the product label states no numeric bandpass.
MEDA RDS measurements are not galactic cosmic-ray dose, solar energetic-particle dose, absorbed dose, dose equivalent, or astronaut exposure.
Dust optical depth is unavailable in the parsed products.
